description: Remove hidden metadata from an image before sharing it, on-device (same cleaner as ruah.tools): EXIF (GPS location, camera and device, date taken), XMP, IPTC, comments, embedded thumbnails and extra data such as motion-photo video. JPEG and PNG are cleaned losslessly — only the image data and its display settings (colour profile, orientation) are copied, not re-encoded — so the photo looks exactly the same. Other formats (HEIC from an iPhone, AVIF, GIF, …) are rebuilt from their pixels with no metadata at all: WebP stays WebP, images with transparency become PNG, photos become JPEG (quality 92). Saves a new file; the original is never changed. The result lists what was removed (e.g. a GPS location) and what is left — no need to check with other tools. Use for "remove EXIF", "strip GPS / location", "clean metadata before posting".

input_path.description: Image file to clean. Absolute, ~/…, or relative to the working directory.

output_path.description: Where to save. Default: "<name>-clean.<ext>" next to the input. Existing files are never overwritten.

name: strip_metadata
title: Remove metadata
